findings.claim: The mounted materializer receipt is forced to "Passed" instead of being derived from the recorded checks or final materialized state, masking silent acceptance failures.
findings.evidence: The continuation hunk replaces `result: withinMemoryBudget ? "Passed" : "Failed"` with `result: "Passed"` while still emitting counts and hard-coded check booleans; acceptance requires preserving SQL/checkpoint atomicity, owner fencing, and behavior preservation rather than unconditional success.
findings.suggested_fix: Compute `result` from explicit boolean checks, including final SQL counts/evidence states/checkpoint shapes and any required durability/fencing assertions, and write `Failed` when any check is false.

findings.claim: The new materialization runner defaults its receipt path to the old runtime-architecture RA11c location instead of the pri-c014 production-readiness evidence directory.
findings.evidence: `DEFAULT_OUTPUT` is `.kbd-orchestrator/phases/runtime-architecture/evidence/ra-11c-sql-materialization/task-4-mounted-acceptance.json`, while acceptance task 5 requires saving the source-bound receipt under `.kbd-orchestrator/phases/production-readiness-integration/evidence/pri-c014-aso-memory/`.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the default output to `.kbd-orchestrator/phases/production-readiness-integration/evidence/pri-c014-aso-memory/browser-campaign.json` or require `--output` with no stale default.
